description: Attributed conversions, converters and revenue per currency. Pass broadcast_id for a campaign, broken down per A/B variant with its sent count and rate, or automation_id for a sequence, broken down per step. The figures are attributed, not causal: each conversion counts for the last email its person clicked, and scanner clicks and opens never count. The rate is people over messages sent. A conversion appears about a minute after its event, once the clicks before it are classified.

goal_id.description: Only this goal's conversions; every goal when omitted

name: get_conversion_metrics
